# MethylationRegulation

This document merges every source file of the MethylationRegulation folder. DNA
methylation (mQTL) is used as the exposure to describe the methylation layer of the
prioritized signals.

The shell scripts run three sets of SMR analyses with the SMR 1.3.1 executable: mQTL
against sleep apnea, mQTL against gene expression (mQTL-eQTL) and mQTL against plasma
protein (mQTL-pQTL); the R scripts collect the per-chromosome results, apply the FDR
correction and export the significant methylation probes.

## Notes on the merged code

* Each section below holds one source file of this folder, and the file name is given
  both in the section heading and in the first comment line of the chunk.
* Every path that pointed at the analysis tree of the original workstation is rewritten
  to a short relative path below the placeholder root `Path/`; `Path/datasource/` stands
  for the input data, `Path/R-4.3.1/bin/` for the R interpreter and
  `Path/SMR/smr-1.3.1-win-x86_64/` for the SMR executable. Point them at your own
  installation before running the code.
* The Chinese comments and chunk titles of the original scripts are given in English;
  the date of the original document header is not part of this merged file.
* Shell scripts are kept in their own `bash` chunks.

---

## `SMRmQTL_SleepApnea_code.txt`

```{bash "SMRmQTL_SleepApnea_code.txt", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: SMRmQTL_SleepApnea_code.txt (shell script)
# ===========================================================================
#blood DNAm SMR
cat Path/datasource/mQTL_data/mqtlchr_EUR.txt | while read line;
do
echo "Now reading:"$line
var=${line:0:(-1)};
Path/SMR/smr-1.3.1-win-x86_64/smr-1.3.1-win.exe --bfile Path/g1000/EUR --gwas-summary Path/datasource/GWAS_data/SleepApnea_SMR.txt --beqtl-summary Path/datasource/mQTL_data/"$var" --maf 0.01 --out Path/MethylationRegulation/"$var"_SleepApnea --thread-num 10
echo "Probe "$var" has finished"
done


#brain DNAm SMR
Path/SMR/smr-1.3.1-win-x86_64/smr-1.3.1-win.exe --bfile Path/g1000/EUR --gwas-summary Path/datasource/GWAS_data/SleepApnea_SMR.txt --beqtl-summary Path/datasource/mQTL_data/Brain-mMeta --maf 0.01 --out Path/MethylationRegulation/Brain_SleepApnea --thread-num 10
```

## `SMRmQTL_SleepApnea_Rcode.Rmd`

```{r "SMRmQTL_SleepApnea_Rcode.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: SMRmQTL_SleepApnea_Rcode.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(openxlsx)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(data.table)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Read the blood DNAm SMR results
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
setwd("Path/MethylationRegulation/")
mqtlchr<-read.table("Path/datasource/mQTL_data/mqtlchr_EUR.txt")

all_results<-data.frame(mqtlchr=NA,probeID=NA,ProbeChr=NA,Gene=NA,Probe_bp=NA,topSNP=NA,topSNP_chr=NA,topSNP_bp=NA,A1=NA,A2=NA,Freq=NA,b_GWAS=NA,se_GWAS=NA,p_GWAS=NA,b_eQTL=NA,se_eQTL=NA,p_eQTL=NA,b_SMR=NA,se_SMR=NA,p_SMR=NA,p_HEIDI=NA,nsnp_HEIDI=NA)

for (id in mqtlchr[[1]]) {
  results<-read.delim(paste(id,"SleepApnea.smr",sep = "_"),
                      header = TRUE,stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  if(nrow(results)!=0){
    results$mqtlchr<-id
    all_results<-rbind(all_results,results)
  }
}
all_results<-all_results[-1,]

all_results$fdr<-p.adjust(all_results$p_SMR,method = "fdr",n = length(all_results$p_SMR))
all_results$BETA<-paste(round(all_results$b_SMR,3)," (",round(all_results$b_SMR-1.96*all_results$se_SMR,3),"-",round(all_results$b_SMR+1.96*all_results$se_SMR,3),")",sep = "")
all_results$OR<-paste(round(exp(all_results$b_SMR),3)," (",round(exp(all_results$b_SMR-1.96*all_results$se_SMR),3),"-",round(exp(all_results$b_SMR+1.96*all_results$se_SMR),3),")",sep = "")

write.xlsx(all_results,"ALL_Blood_SleepApnea.xlsx")

all_results<-subset(all_results,all_results$fdr<0.05)
all_results<-subset(all_results,all_results$p_HEIDI>0.01)

write.xlsx(all_results,"Sig_Blood_SleepApnea.xlsx")

write.table(all_results$probeID,"Sig_Blood_SleepApnea_DNAm.txt",row.names = F,col.names = F,quote = FALSE)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Read the brain DNAm SMR results
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
setwd("Path/MethylationRegulation/")

results<-read.delim("Brain_SleepApnea.smr",header = TRUE,stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

results$fdr<-p.adjust(results$p_SMR,method = "fdr",n = length(results$p_SMR))
results$BETA<-paste(round(results$b_SMR,3)," (",round(results$b_SMR-1.96*results$se_SMR,3),"-",round(results$b_SMR+1.96*results$se_SMR,3),")",sep = "")
results$OR<-paste(round(exp(results$b_SMR),3)," (",round(exp(results$b_SMR-1.96*results$se_SMR),3),"-",round(exp(results$b_SMR+1.96*results$se_SMR),3),")",sep = "")
write.xlsx(results,"ALL_Brain_SleepApnea.xlsx")
results<-subset(results,results$fdr<0.05)
results<-subset(results,results$p_HEIDI>0.01)
write.xlsx(results,"Sig_Brain_SleepApnea.xlsx")

write.table(results$probeID,"Sig_Brain_SleepApnea_DNAm.txt",row.names = F,col.names = F,quote = FALSE)
```

## `SMRmQTLeQTL_code.txt`

```{bash "SMRmQTLeQTL_code.txt", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: SMRmQTLeQTL_code.txt (shell script)
# ===========================================================================
#blood DNAm gene SMR
cat Path/datasource/mQTL_data/mqtlchr_EUR.txt | while read line;
do
echo "Now reading:"$line
var=${line:0:(-1)};
Path/SMR/smr-1.3.1-win-x86_64/smr-1.3.1-win.exe --bfile Path/g1000/EUR --beqtl-summary Path/datasource/mQTL_data/"$var"  --beqtl-summary Path/datasource/eQTL_data/Whole_Blood/Whole_Blood --extract-exposure-probe Path/MethylationRegulation/Sig_Blood_SleepApnea_DNAm.txt --extract-outcome-probe Path/Colocalization/Sig_BloodGene_SleepApnea_probe.txt --maf 0.01 --out Path/MethylationRegulation/Blood_"$var"_mQTLeQTL_SleepApnea --thread-num 10
echo "Probe "$var" has finished"
done


#brain DNAm gene SMR
Path/SMR/smr-1.3.1-win-x86_64/smr-1.3.1-win.exe --bfile Path/g1000/EUR --beqtl-summary Path/datasource/mQTL_data/Brain-mMeta  --beqtl-summary Path/datasource/eQTL_data/Brain_Frontal_Cortex_BA9/Brain_Frontal_Cortex_BA9 --extract-exposure-probe Path/MethylationRegulation/Sig_Brain_SleepApnea_DNAm.txt --extract-outcome-probe Path/Colocalization/Sig_BrainGene_SleepApnea_probe.txt --maf 0.01 --out Path/MethylationRegulation/Brain_mQTLeQTL_SleepApnea --thread-num 10
```
